Cp. Milton’s description of his own situation after the Restoration: ‘On evil days though fall’n, and evil
tongues’ (PL vii 26). S. later applied the same phrase to Godwin (LMG 198).
 Since meanly he for gold c.d sell draft.
 god of blood] S. had evidently seen Wordsworth’s Thanksgiving Ode, January 18 1816, with other
short pieces, which contained the notorious ‘Ode 1815’ 106–9: ‘But Thy most dreaded instrument,/In
working out a pure intent,/Is Man — arrayed for mutual slaughter,/Yes, Carnage is thy daughter!’. Other
poems in the collection expressed similar sentiments.
 bought] Wordsworth had accepted a minor post under Government in 1813.
 ‘The hopes he despises were once his own, the reactionary victors of Europe were once his
enemies, his principles are forgotten; but no matter: it is fitting that he denied the authority of Truth
before betraying his own poetic powers’.

paragraphs.source_en:
65 The stem whence thou wert disunited
Since thy poor self was banished hither,
Now by that priest of Nature’s care
Who sent thee forth to wither
His window with its blooms has lighted,
70 And I shall see thy brethren there,
And each like thee will aye betoken
Love sold, hope dead, and honour broken.
